doc: Defaults of the optional arguments: streak = 0.0 (scalar, so the shield texture is the constant 1 - 0.3 * 0.5) and subtexel = None (the binomial branch not taken), float32 fields, float64 threshold column. Tolerance is the golden float32 default. Arguments: s, fine, t, streak and subtexel are the inputs of that name when listed; an unlisted t, streak (default 0.0) is the scalar in params, an unlisted subtexel is None; prm holds the GenParams fields compose reads (the others keep their defaults). params.result_dtype ("f64" or "f32") is the dtype numpy gives the result by promotion (a float64 t array or float64 inputs give f64, a python-float t with float32 fields keeps f32); it is informational, the stored output has that dtype. Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 5.1e-8; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 1.6e-7 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is 16x the larger of the two spreads.
